text.en:
Upon effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles
specifically listed in the aforesaid "Annex" which are entered and withdrawn from
warehouses in the Philippines for consumption shall be levied the rates of duty
herein prescribed;
All Presidential issuances, administrative rules and
regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are
hereby revoked or modified accordingly;
PGMA Holagram * 22405

This Executive Order shall take effect thirty (30) days
following its complete publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation in
the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 2nd day Outober
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Three.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
PGMA Hologram # 22406
